label: default_glass_detail
reference_prompt: Create a close reference specifically for the subtle visible detail carried by old hand-made transparent glass in a grounded dark-fantasy world. Focus on the faint imperfections that let otherwise clear glass be perceived: whisper-thin waviness, sparse tiny bubbles, minute flow lines, slight thickness distortions and restrained weather haze. These details must remain delicate and intermittent rather than covering the surface. Avoid frost, scratches everywhere, cracks, decorative borders, fingerprints or strong reflections. This is the almost-invisible material signature of imperfect historic glass—enough physical information to reveal the pane while preserving transparency.
